mechanisms.name: oxygen suppression of alpha to gamma transformation kinetics

evidence.quote: the interstitial oxygen essentially reduces the kinetics of α → γ. Consequently, the fully lamellar is easier formation than the duplex microstructures.
随着 O 含量的增加, 晶粒尺寸较无氧组织明显减小

mechanisms.name: beta to alpha solidification transition induced by oxygen

evidence.quote: O 原子的加入使凝固路径由 β 凝固转变为 α 凝固
